build_RegNet_backbone: build a RegNet backbone model using generate_regnet_parameters and ResBottleneckBlock for feature extraction
build_AnyNet_backbone: build an AnyNet backbone with custom stem_class, block_class, depths, and widths for feature extraction
create_ResBottleneckBlock: create a ResBottleneckBlock with squeeze-and-excitation and grouped convolutions for residual learning
generate_regnet_parameters: generate per-stage widths and depths from RegNet quantization parameters w_a, w_0, w_m, and depth
create_ResStem: create a ResStem module with 7x7 conv, batch norm, activation, and 3x3 max pooling for ImageNet
